reuse.why: Extends the existing isWrittenByMonthAction predicate and the existing getBudgetData/getCategoriesWithGroupHidden queries rather than adding a new mechanism.

duplication.why: The rule lives once in the predicate; only the `goal_def IS NOT NULL AS has_template` column expression is repeated in the two pre-existing category queries.

placement.why: The exclusion rule is placed in the single month-action predicate in budget/actions.ts where the tree centralises it, with data fetched in the same module's queries.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its flag type, the two queries and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Clean and easy to own; the leftover average-only `=== 0` branch next to the new general hidden check is slightly confusing without a comment about the null-group distinction.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep going through isWrittenByMonthAction.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the small has_template SQL expression appears twice, openly, in the two existing queries.

one_place.where: isWrittenByMonthAction in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts decides the hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion for copy, zero and all averages; the has_template column is supplied by both feeding queries.
